messages:
marta: FYI - attempted a staged unpin of runtime v4.0 -> v4.1 for models tagged 'embed-heavy' at 03:00 UTC. Deploybot shows job succeeded in us-east-1 only; metrics look off for embedding QPS (CPU spike).
deploybot: [automated] Unpin job jb_20260330_2045 completed in region: us-east-1. other regions: pending. rollout strategy: staggered-region. ticket: INF-4902
dev-raj: Seeing 20% CPU steal on gpu-hosts for embed-heavy when using v4.1 quant kernels. Memory OK but throughput drops. Logs show more frequent small batches.
sre-lee: Can we roll back the region immediately? If it's only us-east, we should pin back to v4.0 and re-route traffic.
docc: Also, platform docs need a quick blurb. This might trigger customer alerts for embeddings latency.
kiran: Quick checklist: 1) cancel any pending rollouts 2) pin runtime v4.0 in us-east 3) set routing rule for model_tag=embed-heavy -> runtime:v4.0 4) gather perf diffs and upload to INF-4902
marta: I'm cancelling pending jobs now. /deploybot cancel jb_20260330_2045 --region us-east-1
deploybot: [automated] Cancel acknowledged. job jb_20260330_2045 -> status=cancelled in us-east-1. audit_id=audit_2999991234_1
dev-raj: Initiating runtime pin: `/runtimectl pin add runtime:v4.0 --scope region:us-east-1 --reason "post-unpin CPU regressions"`
sre-lee: After pin, I'll add an emergency routing override so that model_tag=embed-heavy shunts to runtime:v4.0 for 30m while we inspect.
docc: I'll draft a short status note for the Release Notes "Incident: runtime v4.1 partial rollout caused embedding latency increase in us-east-1, rollback applied; investigating". Ping me if wording needs customer-friendly language.
kiran: Also notify a couple of top customers using embeddings in us-east via the Account Alerts channel.
marta: Rollback complete: runtime:v4.0 pinned in us-east. Confirming routing rule in place.
dev-raj: Perf diff attached to INF-4902: p95 latency embeddings +45% on v4.1 vs v4.0, CPU +22%. Will run repro with diagnostic flags.
sre-lee: Keep the pin for 4 hours while we troubleshoot. If we can reproduce in staging with smaller models, we'll attempt a kernel patch or re-quantize before rescheduling.
deploybot: [automated] Audit log: action=rollback_region, user=marta, job=jb_20260330_2045, status=rolled_back, ticket=INF-4902
kiran: Decision: rollback held. Next steps: reproduce in staging (dev-raj), doc blurb (docc), customer alerts (kiran). Reschedule tentative narrow window next Thursday 01:30 UTC limited to us-west-2 only.
marta: Thanks team. Thread closed for now, reopen if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
